title: The Ram-Bearer's Primer
summary: A plain primer teaching grip, stance, lift and straight drive of the short hand ram to an untrained student without qi.

title: Short Beam Carrying Drill-Book
summary: A drill-book of repeated carrying exercises for the short beam, teaching balanced lifting, pacing and setting down with a partner.

title: Handbook of the Door Ram
summary: A short handbook for the one-man door ram, teaching where to strike a door and how to spend first qi.

title: A Workbook of Ram Stances
summary: A workbook of stances for holding, braking and driving a ram, built around the legs and hips of a body-only student.

title: The Plain Log-Ram Course
summary: A plain course in swinging a slung log ram with a small crew, adding a thread of qi to the carry.

title: Primer on Hand-Over-Hand Haft Work
summary: A primer on gripping and shifting the hands along the haft so the ram can be braked, turned and driven without losing hold.

title: The Bearer's Pace Handbook
summary: A handbook of pace and count for bearers carrying a heavy ram together, with qi used to even the load.

title: Treatise of the Honest Swing
summary: A treatise on the plain pendulum swing of a slung ram, teaching timing, release and recovery for crews that use qi.

title: Ram-Head Care and First Drives
summary: A beginner's text on the iron-capped head, how to aim it, and the first short drives against timber, for a student with no qi.

title: Breaker's Elementary Canon
summary: An elementary canon of door-breaking, joining stance, drive and recovery, with the first qi-assisted drives.
